title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Checkout Conditions
content:
Equipment of Ridgeline Tool Rental leaves the rental center, or goes out on the delivery truck, at checkout, and the agreement moves from reserved to on rent. The conditions below govern checkout; the class figures they name are on the checkout requirements, deposit and damage protection tables.

**(a) Who may take the equipment.** Equipment is checked out only to a renter who meets the entry requirements of the equipment class (minimum age and number of identification documents) and, in a class where the operating and safety orientation is required, has completed that orientation at the counter.

**(b) Security deposit.** A security deposit of the class's deposit amount is collected at checkout, as a security deposit, on one of the class's deposit tenders, except where it is waived for a rental charged to an active Ridgeline Pro Credit account in a class that allows that waiver.

**(c) Damage protection.** Damage protection is offered at checkout and the agreement records whether it was taken. In a class where damage protection must be taken, it must be taken, except that a renter who presents a commercial certificate of insurance may decline it where the class allows that.

**(d) Due-back time and length.** The due-back time is set from the rate period the renter books, and the total period from checkout may not exceed the class's longest agreement period.

## Damage protection at checkout

| Class requires damage protection | Class allows decline with a certificate | Renter presents a commercial certificate of insurance | Damage protection |
|---|---|---|---|
| no | either | either | renter's choice |
| yes | yes | yes | may be declined |
| yes | yes | no | must be taken |
| yes | no | either | must be taken |

## Hypothetical checks

- A renter aged 20 asks for a boom lift in Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting: the class minimum age is 21, so the lift is not checked out.
- A contractor taking a mini excavator in Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment presents a commercial certificate of insurance and declines damage protection: the class requires protection and allows the decline with a certificate, so the decline stands.
